answer: The smith quenches every blade and stamps it with his mark while the steel is still warm, because a cold stamp can be faked. Air traffic controller licence with aviation authority attestation is that hot stamp: three-year training, 1,000 supervised hours, exam, annual medical. The kernel is one blade, forged from bar iron and ground on the wheel. A blade stamped with a stolen mark is broken at the guild court, and the horizon is the damages, a year's earnings paid to the man whose mark was taken. The relic is the guild book of marks, kept in the hall and shown to every buyer.
